correctness.rationale: The face condition |F∩S|+|F∩P_i|<=2 gives K=join_i E_2(P_i), L=join_i E_1(P_i), core edges Q, and cone attachments indexed by S. L->K is null since dim L=r-1 and K is (2r-2)-connected. Join/Kunneth gives K a wedge of A spheres S^(2r-1), L a wedge of B spheres S^(r-1). Attaching s cones gives sB r-spheres, adding binom(s,2) edges creates that many free H1 generators; natural relative sequences and Koszul swap signs yield the claimed integral homology lattices. Independent fresh face enumeration for s=3,r=3,q=(3,3,3) yielded 538 faces including empty, mod-2 reduced Betti (3,24,1) at degrees (1,3,5). The proof, not that finite check, covers every asserted parameter.
